backend_suite_finding.observation: The full backend suite (341 test files) reached 32% and then hung. The pytest process sat at 0.0% CPU in sleeping state for over 10 minutes with no output advance. Its only child was the multiprocessing resource tracker, so the block is inside the suite, not a runaway subprocess.
backend_suite_finding.suspected_cause: Contention with the live environment. The frontend (3000) and two backends (8765, 8766) were running and holding data/platform/platform.db while the suite executed. A test that binds a fixed port or opens the same SQLite file can block indefinitely.
backend_suite_finding.historical_corroboration: Prior sessions recorded 'Regression Test Output Timeout During M62.9R Certification' and 'Regression Test Output File Still Empty After Timeout' - the same class of symptom.
backend_suite_finding.not_done: No test was skipped, deleted or marked xfail to make the suite pass. The hang is reported as-is.
backend_suite_finding.recommendation: Add pytest-timeout (already declared in pyproject dev extras but NOT installed in the shared venv) and run the backend suite with all local services stopped.
